opportunities.point: Management expects the B2B to B2C sales mix to reach 50-50 in a year or two and 75-25 in the long term.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "For revenue mix, we see that job work percentage right now in Quarter 1 stands at 54% and, the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The company expects 18-karat jewellery to represent at least 20% of its corporate sales mix by the end of the year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So we have introduced this since December, our sales mix in corporate, before it was 100% 22 carat, I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: RBZ Jewellers plans to launch its Surat store in Quarter 2 and Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores in Quarter 3.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: The capital expenditure incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR 10 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Carrying inventory in an unhedged open position poses commodity price risks to ongoing business operations.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Now what you talk about the inventory levels, it is a directional call that we have taken that on an ongoing business if we were to, put our inventory and this amount of inventory onto, let's say in an open position, it is going to call for risk." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: The company notes that recent restrictions on gold imports are not advantageous.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Certainly, I think these restrictions are not advantageous, but up to what level there is an impact is crucial." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The industry sentiment and buying remain low in late quarter 1 post Akshay Tritiya.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Now when you talk about the industry quarter 1 post Akshay Tritiya remains low in terms of sentiments and all in the buying -- there is no buying season as such in late quarter 1." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec) are still in the cycle.
threats.evidence: Negative quarters: Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec
